scope: Reference target filename compatibility, not source-title rewriting
allowed: Other printable characters including spaces, commas, parentheses, apostrophes and Unicode; existing vault filenames already use these. No ASCII-only requirement is imposed.
canonical_existing_note: Match verified source title via existing-paper-targets.json, use exact existing filename stem; retain source display title as alias when needed.
unimported_reference: Filename-safe source-title-derived target, exact source title as display alias. Missing note is allowed.
audit_scope: One-to-one titles and order from source bibliography; source bibliography typos can be corrected with authoritative DOI publisher evidence in automation.
